title: echium italicum var. balearicum
intro: Echium italicum var. balearicum, commonly known as Balearic Pride of Madeira or Balearic Viper's Bugloss, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Echium italicum var. balearicum include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
